subject.title: fix: block workspace dotenv endpoint overrides [AI]

question: Should all workspace `.env` keys ending in `_ENDPOINT` be blocked as untrusted outbound-routing controls, accepting migration for existing endpoint environment users?
rationale: The implementation is correct and well-proven, but it intentionally expands a shipped trust boundary and permanently reserves a broad namespace, which requires maintainer policy ownership.

options.title: Accept suffix-wide boundary
options.body: Land the centralized rule and own the documented migration to process environment, global dotenv, shell import, or explicit config.

options.title: Narrow to known endpoint keys
options.body: Use explicit shipped endpoint variables if maintainers do not want every future `_ENDPOINT` name reserved.

recommendation.title: Accept suffix-wide boundary
recommendation.body: Land the centralized rule and own the documented migration to process environment, global dotenv, shell import, or explicit config.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced both the original workspace dotenv trust boundary and the existing connector endpoint blocking behavior.
